fact: The driver of Car 22 failed to maintain a 10 car-length distance from the car in front, behind the Safety Car.
offence: Breach of Article 55.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. Although the gap to the previous car exceeded the 10 car lengths prescribed in the regulations, the Stewards considered the weather conditions and also that the correct gap was restored well prior to the restart, as mitigating circumstances in this case. Hence no penalty is applied.
rules_referenced: Article 55.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
